test.text: Check that the screen reader announces "Select option" before the dropdown.
Tab to the select and confirm the label is read.

steps: Add an aria-label attribute to the <select> element.
Provide a concise, descriptive label text.
Ensure the label is not empty.
Verify the label is read by assistive technology.
content.explanation: The <select> lacks an accessible name, so screen readers cannot identify it. Adding an aria-label gives it a clear name for all users.

verification.note: axe-core fails the original snippet and passes the fixed one.
